name: architecture-crdts
description: Use when the user asks about CRDTs, real-time collaborative editing, Yjs, Automerge, Loro, local-first apps, offline sync with automatic merge or OT vs CRDT. Produces CRDT type and library choice, sync and persistence architecture. Not for consensus-based consistency (use distributed-consensus) or offline caching without concurrent edits (use mobile-offline-first).
